verdict.rationale: This axis applies to a hosted data-pipeline service like Jitsu, since a vendor could state an AI-training opt-out or a no-training policy. Nothing in the evidence addresses whether customer data is used to train AI models, or offers any opt-out. Self-hosting, encryption, SOC 2 and the DPA are adjacent privacy controls and do not establish this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
